name: ReqKey
free_limit: 5,000,000 requests/month; 1,000 API keys; unlimited APIs; 1 workspace member
watch_out: A billable-meter request means one API key validation OR one logged API call; using both can consume two units for the same application request. Free traffic is not hard-stopped immediately above the allowance, but the provider may request a tier upgrade for sustained overuse; its pricing FAQ says over-allowance accepted traffic is not retroactively billed. No credit card required.
